title: Copy-state run invariant
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with no work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, and let $q$ be a state. Suppose that for every input symbol and work-tape tuple, in state $q$ the transition on a bit $b$ moves right, emits $b$, and returns to $q$, while on blank it stays in place, emits nothing, and halts. For every finite Boolean string $x$, output string $o$, and $j\le |x|$, after $j$ steps from the scan configuration at position $0$ in state $q$ with output $o$, the machine is in state $q$ at position $j$ with output $o$ followed by the first $j$ entries of $x$.
